description: New in TD 2025.3: Traces 2D inputs (images, textures, TOPs) into line strip geometry. Derived from Polygonize POP but specialized for 2D tracing. Replaces the 2D functionality that was removed from Polygonize POP. Optimized for outputting line strips for laser, LED, and vector workflows.

parameters.name: Trace Mode
parameters.description: Auto mode detects edges automatically. Threshold uses a brightness threshold. Alpha uses alpha channel transparency.

parameters.name: Threshold
parameters.description: Brightness threshold for edge detection when Trace Mode is Threshold or Auto.

parameters.name: Smoothing
parameters.description: Number of smoothing iterations applied to the traced line strips. Higher values produce smoother curves.

parameters.name: Simplify
parameters.description: Line simplification tolerance. Higher values reduce point count by collapsing collinear segments.

parameters.name: Scale
parameters.description: Output scale factor for the traced geometry.

parameters.name: Output
parameters.description: Line Strips outputs connected line primitives. Points outputs individual unconnected points.

parameters.name: Reverse Direction
parameters.description: Reverses the winding direction of all traced line strips.

useCases: Tracing image contours to line strips for laser projection
Edge detection producing vector geometry for LED walls
2D input tracing for generative art workflows
Converting raster logos to navigable line geometry
Input for Triangulate POP to create filled meshes from traces

commonCombinations: TOP to POP → Trace POP (convert image to line geometry)
Trace POP → Triangulate POP (create filled mesh from trace)
Trace POP → Line Thick POP (thicken lines for rendering)
Trace POP → Line Resample POP (uniform point spacing)
Trace POP → Noise POP (displace traced lines organically)
Trace POP → GLSL POP (custom line manipulation)
Trace POP → Render TOP (line strip rendering)

troubleshooting.solution: Ensure input is a 2D image/TOP with sufficient contrast. Adjust Threshold parameter — too high or too low will produce empty results.
Increase Smoothing iterations (try 4-6) and increase Simplify tolerance to reduce point noise.

troubleshooting.problem: Traced geometry doesn't match image size
troubleshooting.solution: Use Scale parameter or a Transform POP to match the output to your desired viewport dimensions.

troubleshooting.problem: Trace POP crashes with large images
troubleshooting.solution: Downscale the input image first with a Level TOP or Resolution TOP before tracing. Very high resolution images with complex contours can be slow.

localNotes.excerpt: Trace POP: Derived from Polygonize POP but specialized for tracing 2D inputs. Optimized for outputting line strips. Use Trace POP for 2D tracing instead of Polygonize POP (which now only accepts 3D input).
